title: HateBR: A Large Expert Annotated Corpus of Brazilian Instagram Comments for Offensive Language and Hate Speech Detection
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech related to religious intolerance within Brazilian Portuguese Instagram comments.
findings: The paper created and validated the HateBR corpus, which includes 'religious intolerance' as one of nine hate speech categories. The corpus contains 47 instances of religious intolerance, but the paper does not provide specific performance metrics or analysis for this category alone.
